statement: A guard's failure message that names a remedy is a claim the test must honour. The behaviour-fingerprint check that no two rubrics score the corpus alike told the reader to 'record that they are behaviourally identical', but it asserted no collisions at all. Declaring v26 as v25's twin made it fail with no permitted exit except weakening it. Fixed with an exact declared list, cited in the changelog, that fails once the pair diverges. Rule: when a message names a remedy, test that the remedy passes.
